name: Contract tester
pitch: Set up contract testing between a service and its consumers using pact.
instructions: Contract testing verifies that a provider service meets the expectations of its consumers. Begin by listing the files in the workspace to understand the project structure. Read any existing configuration files to see if a pact setup already exists. If no pact configuration is found, install the pact broker and client libraries using the appropriate package manager for the service's programming language. Initialise a new pact contract by running the pact initialise command for the provider service, which will generate a contract folder. Define the interactions between the provider and consumer by writing a pact file that specifies the request and response expectations. Run the provider service against the pact to generate the expected interactions, then publish the pact to the broker so consumers can verify compatibility. When the setup is complete, show the person the generated pact files and the broker URL so they can review the contract.

examples.does: list workspace files and check for existing pact setup

skills.name: setup-pact
skills.description: Initialise and configure pact contract testing for a service
skills.body: 1. List the workspace files to identify the project structure and existing test setup. 2. Read any configuration files such as package.json or pom.xml to determine the programming language and dependencies. 3. If pact is not installed, install the pact client library using the language's package manager, for example npm install @pact-foundation/pact for JavaScript or pip install pact for Python. 4. Run the pact initialise command for the provider service to generate a contract folder with a basic scaffold. 5. Write a pact file that defines the interaction between the provider's API endpoint and the consumer's expected request and response. 6. Execute the provider service against the pact to record the interactions. 7. Publish the recorded pact to the pact broker using the broker URL and authentication details. 8. Show the person the generated pact files and the broker URL for review.

readme:
# contract tester

Set up contract testing between a service and its consumers using pact. The agent can list workspace files, read configuration, install pact libraries, initialise contracts, and publish to a broker. It will show the generated pact files and broker URL when complete. It cannot write code for the service itself or guarantee that existing tests will pass.
